expect.outcome: Preserve recorded decisions through policy change and migration.

authority.owner: Treasury policy owner and ledger maintainer

acceptance: Replay keeps the saved answer; conflicts preserve history; reevaluation creates a linked ID; migration requires original evidence and commits atomically.

stop_conditions: Missing historical provenance, conflicting identity or unavailable policy mapping.
Protected inputs change or the declared attempt/time budget is spent.

checks.expected: Selected public checks pass on unchanged inputs.
Current candidate completes its scoped continuation; inspect retained observations.

decide.owner: Learner reviewer; Treasury policy owner and ledger maintainer for a changed rule.
decide.object: B3 candidate, identified bytes and its scoped handoff.
